text:
amanda: Drafting the Observability Console PRD (retention + traces + UX). Need quick sync on what’s in the MVP vs follow-ups. TL;DR: dashboards, trace linking from spans -> logs, retention tiers, simple sampling UI, launch criteria + rollback plan.

raj: +1. Can we be specific about which metrics dashboards are required for launch? engineering bandwidth is tight.

amanda: Core dashboards for launch: token-cost per-route, p50/p95 latency per-model, per-tenant errors, successful requests per-second. Tracing: ability to click from a request in the dashboard to a full trace view (last 72h). Retention tiers: 7d free, 30d standard, 90d enterprise.

leo: UX note — trace view needs clear breadcrumb to go back to the route/req. Also add a compact sampling toggle (on/off) with an info tooltip. Don't ship an advanced query builder in MVP.

marta: SRE constraints: we can't keep full traces at 90d without aggressive sampling + compression. Need quotas per-tenant and a hard cap fallback. Also GDPR delete-by-request must reach all stores within 24h.

raj: Implementation constraints: current runtime only exports KV cache traces in protobuf blobs. To support trace linking we'll need a lightweight indexing layer (redis -> trace-id map) and a read path performance budget: p95 trace retrieval < 150ms for 72h window. If that sounds ok I can staff a small epic.

amanda: Good catch. Prioritization proposal: MVP must meet product observable needs and compliance. Out-of-scope for MVP: advanced retention tiering per-route, query builder, long-term cold-storage UI. Follow-up work after launch.

raj: Proposed acceptance criteria (please react):
```
- Dashboards: token-cost, latency (p50/p95), errors, rps live for all paid customers.
- Trace linking: click -> trace payload returns within 150ms for traces <=72h.
- Retention tiers: UI to select 7d/30d/90d and enforcement on backend with sampling config.
- Sampling: toggle (on/off) and a simple rate selector (1%, 5%, 10%).
- GDPR: delete request processed and confirmed within 24h.
- Rollout: canary to 2% tenants, health checks for 48h, auto-rollback on error spike (>3x baseline errors).
```

leo: UX acceptance items: compact trace header, back-to-dashboard breadcrumb, sampling tooltip copy, no-login-preview for demo tenants.

marta: Edge cases to call out: tenant exceeded retention cap (notify + pause writes), partial deletion failures (retry with exponential backoff + alert), cross-region traces (ensure consistent index replication).

amanda: On prioritization: customers pushing for 90d are Enterprise pilots (Acme & FinCo). We should gate 90d behind Dedicated/Enterprise plans and add quotas. If we can't meet 90d for hosted immediately, document it in PRD and offer a migration path.

raj: Rollback plan sketch: feature flag + config per-tenant. Canary -> watch alerts for latency, error-rate, and cost anomalies. If triggered, flip flag to previous behavior and run a background reindex for traces ingested during canary. Need runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy started: observability-console/feature/trace-linking -> staging (build 0.9.3) :rocket:

amanda: Next steps: I'll update PRD with these acceptance criteria and edge cases, draft rollout runbook, and tag owners. Ask: raj can you own the trace index epic? leo own trace UX microflows? marta own rollout/checklist?

raj: I can take the trace index epic, will add tech design doc by EOD Friday.

leo: I'll prototype microflows and tooltip copy, aim for mock by Tue.

marta: I'll draft the runbook and failure scenarios, will coordinate with infra to validate quota enforcement.

amanda: Great. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll lock MVP scope and start PR review. :thumbsup:
